description: WARM verifiable agent memory — Persistent memory for AI agents as a pay-per-call API, no database to run. op=remember stores subject-predicate-object facts (or extracts them from free text; only facts whose subject and object appear verbatim are kept); a newer value for the same subject and predicate supersedes the old one, and the history stays queryable. op=recall searches by BM25 keyword ranking or exact triple pattern, now

asOf.description: Epoch milliseconds or an ISO 8601 date/time (UTC when no offset).

predicate.description: Single-valued slot per subject, e.g. lives_in; a newer fact supersedes the older.

validFrom.description: Epoch milliseconds or an ISO 8601 date/time (UTC when no offset).

validTo.description: Epoch milliseconds or an ISO 8601 date/time (UTC when no offset).

history.description: recall: only facts current at asOf (default) or every status.

pattern.description: Exact (case- and whitespace-insensitive) match on any of subject, predicate, object.

source.description: remember: provenance label for facts extracted from text.

tenantId.description: Required for API-key callers (namespace as key:<tenantId>; keep it unguessable). Ignored when a wallet paid.

text.description: remember: free text; facts are extracted by a fast model and kept only if subject and object occur verbatim.

name: warm-memory
